inputs.text: Vertical cinematic medium shot inside the same modern Chinese apartment study at evening. The same adult Chinese woman age 28 sits at a wooden desk beside an open laptop. One black smartphone lies face-down on the desk near her right hand; only its matte rear shell and small camera module are visible, never the display. She looks down toward the phone with slightly furrowed eyebrows and reaches toward its side edge. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll film, soft flocked fabric, fine textile fibers, rounded adult chibi proportions, cold white practical light with a warm desk lamp, clean 9:16 composition. Exactly one phone, rear side toward camera, no visible screen, no interface, no generated text, natural hands. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: she looks at the laptop while one phone lies face-down beside her right hand, rear camera module visible. Action: the phone vibrates once; she turns her eyes toward it, grips it by the side edges, and slowly lifts it without rotating its rear side toward the camera. End: she brings it beside her right ear and listens, with only the back and side of the phone visible. Motion is slow and subtle. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. No dialogue or lip movement.
